tool_args.rationale: Ten paid rows show a concave increasing substrate response and smooth suppression as gradient increases. Fit the compact four-parameter saturating-substrate model with exponential gradient attenuation numerically; use fresh confirmation to assess its forecast accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; off-baseline gradient rows establish a strong smooth gradient effect.
Already acquired; the added substrate/gradient coverage supports fitting a compact stationary response without further measurements.
The observed response rises with substrate near baseline gradient rather than showing a downturn.
The near-baseline substrate series is clearly concave and saturating, unlike a simple power law.
Observed gradients do not exceed the cited critical regime, and the changes look smooth rather than avalanche-like.
